title: Refill Dispensing Rules for the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program
content:
A refill on the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program ships only while the program is active; a program in referral received, pending authorization, on hold or closed receives no refill.

## Dispensing clauses

**R1 — Authorization drawn.** Each refill draws on one authorization grant of the program, recorded on the shipment, and the ship date must be on or before the valid-through date on the authorization being drawn.

**R2 — Authorized units.** The units shipped may not exceed the program's authorized units remaining. Authorized units remaining are the billing units still available to ship under the program's authorization grants — credited by each grant and by accepted returns, debited by each refill shipment.

**R3 — Supply days.** The supply days of a shipment are the tier's supply days per shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain; the units and pieces follow from the supply days under the program's fill quantity rule.

**R4 — Customer confirmation.** On tiers where refill confirmation is required, the refill ships only after the customer personally confirms, for this shipment, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand; the confirmation date is recorded on the shipment, Larkfield never ships those tiers automatically, and Larkfield's own refill reminder for those tiers is made no sooner than the tier's refill contact lead in calendar days before the planned ship date. On the self-pay tier refills ship on the subscription schedule without a per-shipment confirmation. The confirmation is the customer's own statement for this program and this shipment.

**R5 — Refill too soon.** The next refill of the same item ships no earlier than the tier's refill ship lead in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill shipment of that item, counted in calendar days: the previous refill's ship date plus its supply days gives the end of its supply, the earliest permitted ship date is the refill ship lead in calendar days before that end date, and shipping on that earliest date is allowed. A replacement shipment never counts as the previous refill.

**R6 — Coverage verification.** The coverage record the program bills must have been verified with the payer within the tier's coverage reverification period in calendar months before the ship date, as shown by the coverage record's last verified date; the self-pay tier has no coverage to verify.

**R7 — Shipping charges.** Standard ground shipping is free on insured tiers; on the self-pay tier standard shipping costs the tier's standard shipping fee, posted as a patient charge, unless the shipment's cash-price total reaches the free-shipping threshold. Expedited shipping is provided on the customer's request for the expedited shipping fee, posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed, and is recorded as expedited at no charge when the expedite only makes up for a delay Larkfield caused.

**R8 — Billing route.** A refill on a payer tier is billed to the payer by claim with the ship date as the date of service; a refill on the self-pay tier is charged to the customer at the Larkfield cash price.

**R9 — Inpatient stays.** On tiers where an inpatient hold is required, nothing ships while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility; the program is held under the program's hold and closure rules.

## Earliest ship date, worked through (hypothetical figures)

The earliest permitted ship date lies a number of days after the previous refill's ship date equal to its supply days less the refill ship lead.

| Previous refill shipped | Supply days | End of supply | Refill ship lead | Earliest ship date | Ship on 2026-05-12? | Ship on 2026-05-13? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-02 | 90 | 2026-05-31 | 18 days | 2026-05-13 | No | Yes |

## Coverage verification, worked through (hypothetical figures)

With a reverification period of 6 calendar months and a last verified date of 2026-01-15, a refill may ship on any date through 2026-07-15; a ship date of 2026-07-16 falls outside the period.

## Supply days near the end of an authorization (hypothetical figures)

On a tier whose supply days per shipment are 90, a refill shipping when 75 days remain before the authorization's valid-through date ships 60 supply days — the two whole 30-day blocks that remain.
